data.summary: Senior Programe Manager with 13+ years of experience driving large scale business change and transformation programes across BFSI and financial services. Known for leading complex, multi-workstream programs within financial crime, compliance, and regulatory transformation landscapes, managing senior stakeholder relationships, and delivering strategic business change initiatives on time and within scope. Brings deep expertise in programe governance, dependency and risk management, business case development, executive presentation, and investment prioritization across complex banking transformation environments. Strong background in financial crime prevention including fraud risk management at NPCI and RBL Bank, providing direct domain adjacency to CLM, CDD, KYC, and AML transformation programes. Experienced in coordinating across compliance, technology, operations, and business workstreams simultaneously in regulated banking environments including Mastercard, NPCI, and RBL Bank. Seeking a Senior Programe Manager role within a global financial institution where business change leadership, CLM and CDD transformation governance, and senior stakeholder management are at the core.

raw_sections.skills:
CORE COMPETENCIES
✔ Business Change Programe Management ✔ CLM and CDD Transformation Governance ✔ Financial Crime and Compliance Domain Knowledge ✔ KYC and AML Regulatory Context ✔ Programe Governance, Risk and Dependency Management ✔ Senior Stakeholder and Executive Engagement ✔ Business Case Development and Investment Prioritization ✔ Executive Presentations and High-impact Documentation ✔ Strategic Planning and Long-term Programe Road mapping ✔ Cross-functional Multi-workstream Coordination ✔ Change Management and Organizational Change Leadership ✔ Agile, Hybrid and Waterfall Delivery ✔ JIRA, Confluence, Azure DevOps and MS Project ✔ PRINCE2 Agile | CSM | CSPO
TOOLS AND TECHNOLOGIES Programe Management: JIRA, Confluence, Rally, MS Project, Advanced Excel, MS Office Suite, MS PowerPoint Delivery Tools: Azure DevOps, Azure Repos, CI/CD Pipeline Governance Methodologies: Agile / Scrum, SAFe, PRINCE2 Agile, Waterfall, Hybrid Delivery, Change Management Domains: Business Change and Transformation, Financial Crime Compliance, Fraud Risk, KYC and AML Adjacent, CLM and CDD Transformation, M&A Integration, Corporate Security, Digital Payments, BFSI
raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Program Manager | Pyx Tech Pvt. Ltd., Pune | Apr 2025 - Jun 2026
Led large scale business change programes across 3 concurrent client engagements, driving strategic transformation initiatives involving multiple workstreams, senior stakeholders, and competing priorities simultaneously.
Developed business cases, executive presentations, and high impact programe documentation for client leadership, directly influencing investment decisions and strategic priorities across all engagements.
Established programe governance frameworks from scratch, managing dependencies, risks, and stakeholder expectations across all workstreams, ensuring consistent delivery standards and executive visibility throughout.
Governed a multi-partner transformation programe for a global technology client, coordinating five independent external organizations simultaneously toward a single committed go-live date, managing integration dependencies and cutover execution.
Delivered a real time Reporting Dashboard from requirements through production go-live, managing 30 defects across 8 one- week sprints through Azure DevOps pipelines, achieving zero disruption at production deployment.
Led business change investment prioritization across all client accounts, aligning programe priorities with overall business and workstream strategies and ensuring resources were directed toward highest value initiatives.
Managed programe budgets, financial governance, and variance analysis across all engagements, producing regular financial updates and forecasts for senior leadership.
Lead Technical Program Manager | Mastercard, Pune | May 2018 - Apr 2024 Mergers and Acquisitions, Technical Due Diligence
• Led large scale business change and transformation assessment programes across multiple concurrent M&A engagements, coordinating cross-functional teams spanning engineering, security, legal, compliance, and product workstreams across India, US, and Australia.
• Developed high-impact business case documentation, technical clearance reports, and executive presentations for Corporate
Development and C-suite leadership, directly informing strategic investment and deal structuring decisions.
Led business change investment prioritization across multiple simultaneous M&A engagements, ensuring strategic alignment with corporate development objectives and compressing assessment cycles by 30-40 percent.
Managed programe governance, dependencies, risks, and senior stakeholder expectations across geographically distributed teams, maintaining consistent delivery standards and executive visibility throughout all engagements.
Senior Technical Program Manager, Corporate Security
Governed complex compliance and security transformation programes across Mastercard's global corporate security landscape, acting as the bridge between project teams and the Corporate Security function, ensuring regulatory and audit readiness throughout delivery.
Managed financial crime adjacent programes including security posture assessments, access management reviews, and infrastructure security initiatives, coordinating across compliance, technology, and operations workstreams.
Proactively identified a resource and capacity risk on PayBy Account Australia, escalated to senior leadership with structured impact analysis and recommended solution, resulting in immediate course correction and on-track delivery.
Business Solutions Manager, Fraud Risk Management | RBL Bank Ltd., Mumbai | Oct 2016 - Apr 2018
Led end-to-end implementation of SAS Fraud Management systems within RBL Bank's financial crime compliance framework, owning requirements gathering, BRD documentation, UAT management, and production deployment across multiple fraud channels.
Worked directly within the KYC and AML adjacent regulatory environment of a regulated retail bank, understanding the compliance obligations, customer due diligence requirements, and fraud risk governance that govern banking operations.
Coordinated across compliance, technology, operations, and vendor workstreams simultaneously, managing competing priorities and ensuring regulatory alignment throughout the implementation programme.
Translated complex fraud monitoring and compliance requirements into structured BRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria, bridging the gap between business need and technical delivery in a regulated banking environment.
Assistant Manager, Fraud Risk Management | NPCI (National Payments Corporation of India), Mumbai | 2011 - 2016
Managed fraud risk operations within India's central payments infrastructure, working directly within the financial crime prevention and regulatory compliance ecosystem that governs KYC, AML, and customer due diligence standards across India's banking network.
Governed the onboarding of 15-20 member banks onto NPCI's Fraud Risk Management system, managing the compliance, integration, and operational readiness requirements for each bank's entry into the national fraud monitoring framework. • Maintained MI dashboards and regulatory reporting for fraud trends, system performance, and compliance metrics, directly supporting RBI's regulatory oversight requirements for India's payments infrastructure.
